why: The narrowest tier's query widened until it swallows every phone, which is the plausible wrong edit rather than an absurd one -- a reader who sees three lines fixing 320px may reasonably think three lines is simply better everywhere. It is not: three lines is the answer to a 218px text column, and applying it at 390px (288px of column, where every intent fits two) reserves an empty third line on all seven cards, ~30px down the phone column that issue #658's fit complaint was about. The tiers track the TEXT COLUMN, not the viewport, which is also why they are not monotonic.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole holds every map card to one height: every intent tier clamps and reserves the SAME number of lines
